e0-context.title: Load baseline context
e0-context.imperative: Read docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md, docs/agents/GLOSSARY.md, docs/architecture/packets/evo_predictor.md, docs/architecture/packets/latent_power.md, issue 292, and interrogation.json. Confirm the frozen plan protects current stateless latent-power/gold-cycle/sampled-runtime observability without recursive training or objective changes, then attest c1.

postconditions.statement: orchestrator context, glossary, evo and latent_power packets, issue, and interrogation loaded; plan intent/scope confirmed
postconditions.satisfied_by: Loaded orchestrator/glossary/evo and latent_power packets, issue 292 via gh, interrogation.json, README/TESTING/docs guidance; frozen plan protects current stateless observability path and excludes recursive/objective/fantasy-training changes.

constraints: No direct FastF1 calls from analysis/model/adapter/predictor code.
Do not implement recursive refinement or unrolled recursive training.
Do not change model objectives by default.
Keep current stateless module/gold-cycle/sampled-runtime path as the single execution path.

g1.title: Flag empty usable module events
g1.imperative: Using TDD, add explicit module uncertainty diagnostic flags for empty or fully skipped usable event sets. The flag must be compact, stable, and visible in the JSON report summary/module entries without changing model training or calibration math.

postconditions.statement: module uncertainty diagnostics expose empty usable event-set flags and focused tests pass

constraints: Fail visibly in report flags; do not silently treat empty scored sets as clean.
Do not alter calibration objective, pairwise loss, model architecture, or training data selection.

g2.title: Gate gold observability in compact validation
g2.imperative: Using TDD, extend compact pipeline validation so committed gold-cycle artifacts either contain or fail clearly on the issue-292 observability surfaces: module baseline comparisons, uncertainty calibration diagnostics, runtime/training parity, event usage with skipped/missing input reporting, and explicit soft/diagnostic flags. Update minimal validation fixtures accordingly.

preconditions.statement: g1 complete or not required for compact validation changes

postconditions.statement: pipeline validation tests cover missing/malformed observability gates and focused tests pass

constraints: Validation failures must name the missing field and owning artifact.
Validation must remain compact and parse committed artifacts only.
Do not require bulky generated arrays or outputs/evo_runs artifacts.

g3.title: Document gate ownership
g3.imperative: Update report/validation documentation so each issue-292 gate has a clear owning artifact or validation section: temporal split invariants, invalid/DQ/non-classified handling, baseline comparisons, sigma/error diagnostics, failure-mode flags, field sanity, and sampled-runtime parity.

preconditions.statement: observability fields and validation behavior are known
preconditions.satisfied_by: g1/g2 complete; validation script and tests define observability surfaces.

postconditions.statement: documentation maps issue-292 gates to artifact owners and docs-only/focused tests pass

constraints: Docs must describe current truth, not old recursive design.
Command-heavy docs updated in this gate must keep Last verified current.

g4.title: Final focused verification
g4.imperative: Run the focused evo tests affected by the change and compact pipeline validation. Record any unavoidable validation blocker as evidence rather than weakening the gates.

postconditions.statement: reviewer approves final diff and evidence

constraints: Do not close by weakening validation expectations.
If compact pipeline validation fails on stale committed artifacts unrelated to the code gates, preserve the failure details as evidence and route follow-up rather than masking it.

triage_candidates.statement: Regenerate committed unc_diag artifact (reports/evo/unc_diag_260526_004033_2018thru2024.json) after g1 summary counter additions; compact validation correctly fails until artifact refresh.
Refresh committed gold-cycle artifacts (2018thru2024 set): add fusion_train_rows, regenerate unc_diag with g1 summary counters, align train_years to canonical 2021-2024 or update canonical policy.
